customers.evidence: We’re focused on serving our clients to help them live their financial lives.

employees.evidence: We want our employees to reach their full potential.

dei.evidence: We believe that diverse backgrounds and experiences make us stronger.

community.evidence: We value the impact art makes on communities and individuals around the world.

shareholders.evidence: We deliver for clients, communities and shareholders

integrity.evidence: We hold ourselves accountable for the disciplined management of risk and for doing the right thing.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice ('we believe', 'we want', 'we strive') with heavy client and shareholder framing. Clients lead the page, followed by shareholders; integrity is framed as risk management. Commitments are stated as beliefs with little hedging. Investor-relations and newsroom navigation make up much of the page. Environment, safety and innovation are absent.
